product_overview: Cabinet Savwa is a Livewire-driven single-page style application for managing a medical practice: patient registration, appointment queue, consultations with billing, cash operations and a public patient portal accessible via signed links.
core_goals: Allow staff to authenticate and access the application dashboard and modules.
Register and maintain patient records and search patients quickly.
Plan, track and manage patient appointments and the waiting queue.
Create consultations that generate invoices and open receipts for printing.
Record cash operations and register payments toward invoices.
Provide a public view (via signed links) for patients to check their appointment or consultation information.
Offer administrative views for user and statistics reporting with exportable summaries.

features.name: Connexion staff
features.description: Authenticate staff using credentials so they can access protected areas of the application.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter login -> Enter password -> Submit credentials -> See /accueil-patient dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter incorrect credentials -> Submit credentials -> See authentication error message

features.name: Accueil et file d'attente patient
features.description: Central dashboard that shows the patient waiting list, allows changing patient statuses and opening Livewire modals for patient actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Authenticate -> Navigate to /accueil-patient -> See current waiting list and next order numbers -> Select a waiting patient -> Mark patient as arrived/confirmed -> Observe patient reorder in the queue

Navigate to /login -> Authenticate -> Navigate to /accueil-patient -> Open a consultation modal for a selected patient -> Fill consultation basic info -> Submit to start the consultation -> See consultation modal closed and queue updated

features.name: Patients (list & creation)
features.description: View the patient directory, search/filter patients and create new patient records.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Authenticate -> Navigate to /patients -> Open patient list -> Use search or filters to find a patient -> See filtered list results
Navigate to /login -> Authenticate -> Navigate to /patients/create -> Fill required patient information -> Submit patient form -> See new patient appear in the patient list
Navigate to /login -> Authenticate -> Navigate to /patients/create -> Submit form with missing required fields -> See validation error messages

features.name: Rendez-vous (appointments)
features.description: Schedule and manage patient appointments, assign order numbers and generate a signed token/QR for public patient access.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Authenticate -> Navigate to /rendez-vous -> View calendar or list of appointments -> Open new appointment form (/rendez-vous/create) -> Search and select patient -> Select date, time and practitioner -> Save appointment -> See appointment in the list and QR/token available

Navigate to /login -> Authenticate -> Navigate to /rendez-vous -> Select an existing 'En Attente' appointment -> Change status to 'Confirmé' or 'En cours' -> See appointment status updated in the list
Navigate to /login -> Authenticate -> Navigate to /rendez-vous/create -> Enter a past date -> Submit -> See validation error about invalid date

features.name: Consultations (medical flow & billing)
features.description: Create a consultation, select acts and payment mode, calculate insurance share, persist invoice and open the receipt PDF.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Authenticate -> Navigate to /consultations/create -> Search and select patient -> Choose consultation type and select acte(s) -> Choose payment mode and insurance options -> Submit consultation -> See receipt PDF open in a new tab and invoice recorded
Navigate to /login -> Authenticate -> Navigate to /consultations/create -> Try to submit without required fields (patient or acte) -> See validation errors preventing save

features.name: Caisse et règlements (cash operations & invoice payments)
features.description: Record daily cash entries/exits, view daily balance and register payments against patient invoices.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Authenticate -> Navigate to /caisse-operations -> Add a cash operation (entry or withdrawal) -> Submit operation -> See daily balance update

Navigate to /login -> Authenticate -> Navigate to /reglement-facture -> Search for patient invoice -> Add payment details and submit payment -> See invoice payment recorded and invoice status update reflected in the list
Navigate to /login -> Authenticate -> Navigate to /reglement-facture -> Attempt to record a payment with invalid amount format -> See validation error and refusal to save

features.name: Interface patient publique
features.description: Allow patients to open a received signed link (QR or email) to view their appointment position, estimated waiting time or consultation summary without authenticating.
user_flows: Open the received patient portal link (QR or email) -> Read displayed appointment position and estimated waiting time -> See current patient in consultation and queue status
Open the received consultation link (QR or email) -> Read consultation summary and available documents

features.name: Statistiques
features.description: View financial statistics and revenues with filters and export options to review practice performance.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Authenticate -> Navigate to /statistiques -> Select date range and practitioner filter -> View revenue and metric summaries on-screen
Navigate to /login -> Authenticate -> Navigate to /statistiques -> Select filters -> Export or print the selected report -> See confirmation that the report export/print action started

features.name: Administration — Users
features.description: Manage application user accounts and roles for staff administration.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Authenticate -> Navigate to /users -> View user list and roles -> Open new user form -> Fill user details and assign role -> Submit form -> See new user in the list
Navigate to /login -> Authenticate -> Navigate to /users -> Create a new user with an email already in use -> Submit -> See validation error about duplicate email
